title: Welcome to LitThread.
subtitle: Set up a desk that works for you. Choose your reading appearance, research tools and library location.

theme.title: Choose your reading surface
theme.desc: Start with LitThread Paper or choose a theme that suits your desk. You can change it later.

agent.title: Connect a research assistant
agent.desc: Choose a compatible ACP agent and complete its installation and login. You can also continue and configure it later in Settings.
agent.none: No agents found yet. Install one on this computer (e.g. opencode or claude-acp), then click Rescan.

translate.title: Set up translation
translate.desc: Choose a translation provider. Online translation depends on service availability; custom providers require their endpoint, model or credentials.
translate.configureOwn: I have my own translation API
translate.probeFail: Check your key and try again

layout.title: Spot figures and formulas automatically
layout.desc: Locate figures, tables and formulas. The local option downloads a model first; you can also configure your own service.
layout.probeFail: Check your key and try again

vault.title: Create your library
vault.desc: A vault is just a plain folder on your computer where papers and notes live. You can create or switch to another one anytime.

sidebar.title: Your vault, your files
sidebar.desc: Each paper is a plain folder with its PDF, notes and LaTeX source — Obsidian, VS Code and Git can take over anytime.

magicWand.title: Add a reference
magicWand.desc: Enter a DOI, arXiv identifier or link to retrieve available metadata and material. {{magicWandShortcut}} opens the input.

workspace.title: Split-screen reading
workspace.desc: Papers open with the PDF on the left and notes on the right. Select text to highlight, annotate, translate or ask.

agent.title: Your agent, ready to help
agent.desc: Connect a configured agent with the current paper as context. Check its answers against the source and citations.

titlebar.title: That's it!
titlebar.desc: Toggle panels here. {{settingsShortcut}} opens Settings, {{quickOpenShortcut}} jumps anywhere. Tutorial notes were created in your vault — start there.

journal.title:
A desk for
your thinking.
journal.description: A few choices to make LitThread feel at home in your workflow.
